'''Ealdorii''', officially the '''Republic of Ealdorii''' a country in Central [[Ayuma]]. It is bordered by [[Zenashan]] to the south, [[Urbiqu]] and [[Ikzen]] to the north, [[Ukhdari]] to the east, the [[Tasa Bay]] to the southeast, [[Arcana]] to the southwest, and [[Praesyu]] to the west. The country covers an area of [[List of countries and dependencies by area|1,563,780]] [[List of countries and dependencies by area|square kilometres (603,779 mi)]] and has a [[List of countries and dependencies by population|population of over 137 million]], making it the 26th largest country by area and the 10th most populous in the world. [[Shurqan]], home to over 13 million people, is the capital city and the largest in the country.

Starting in the 6th millennium BFA, the fertile plains between Ealdorii’s and Ukhdari’s [[Tusil River|Tusil]] and [[Vixon River|Vixon]], referred to as [[Alzuria (region)]], fostered the rise of early cities, civilisations, and empires, including [[Unwosia]], [[Kaaldari]], and [[Lycrian]]. Known as the [[motherland of civilisation]], [[Alzuria (region)]] saw the invention of writing systems, [[wikipedia:Mathematics|mathematics]], navigation, timekeeping, a calendar, [[wikipedia:Astrology|astrology]], the wheel, the sailboat, and a law code. After the [[Ealdorii Empire|Ealdorii]] conquest of [[Alzuria (region)]] in the 2nd century bc, [[Shurqan]] became the capital of the future Empires in [[Alzuria (region)]] and a global cultural and intellectual hub during the [[Latter Alzurian Golden Age]], home to institutions such as the [[Dy University]]. Following Alzuria's burning by the [[Kaastinial Empire]] in 1075, Alzuria came under [[multiple successive empire]]<nowiki/>s and, from the 13th century until the 16th century, was governed within the [[Kattat system]]. Additionally, Alzuria, and specifically Ealdorii, holds [[religious significance]] in multiple major [[global religions]].

After the [[Red War]], the [[Treaty of Freedom]] split Alzuria into two: Ealdorii in the west, and [[Ukhdari]] in the east. Ealdorii has experienced spells of [[significant economic and military growth]] alongside periods of instability and conflict. Ealdorii was established by the [[Estijan Huan]] in 1695. It transitioned into a Huan-influenced [[wikipedia:Republic|independent republic]] in 1700. Following an [[attempted coup]] of the [[Huan-backed government]] in 1739, Ealdorii [[became a republic]] in 1740 with the [[collapse of the Huan]], first led by [[Rauf Idelb]], who presided over the war against [[Zenashan]] from 1743 to 1744 and then [[invaded again]] in 1747. In 1748, a [[Global-led coalition]] of forces sanctioned the nation, and [[Ukhdari]] forces invaded the south to stop the attack on [[Zenashan]], overthrowing Rauf and triggering an insurgency and sectarian violence. The conflict, known as the [[Zenashan War|Zenashan]] [[Zenashan War|War]], ended in 1750. From 1760 to today, Ealdorii faced another war with the rise of [[pro-Rauf terrorist organisations]]. Today, post-war conflict continues at a lower scale, hampering stability and economic opportunities.

A [[wikipedia:Parliamentary_republic|federal parliamentary republic]], Ealdorii is considered an [[emerging major power.]] It is home to a diverse population, geography, and wildlife. Three thirds of Ealdorii are ____, while significant minorities include _____. Ealdorii is ethnically diverse; mostly Ealdorii, as well as [[Ukhdari]], [[Seljan]], [[Paditor|Paditoran]], [[Tybard|Tybardan]], [[Zenashan]], [[Ikzen]], [[Duhmi]], and [[Acrana|Acranan]]. Ealdorii is the official language of Ealdorii, while [[Seljan]], [[Paditor|Paditoran]], and [[Tybard|Tybardan]] are spoken regionally. It is popular for its agriculture and [[tourism]]. At present, Ealdorii is slowly building with foreign support.
